facts.fact: Alex 判断：近九成凶案里受害者认识凶手——让 April 开口就可能锁定人。
facts.anchor: The victim knows their killer in almost ninety percent of homicides.

facts.fact: 信封物证：打印体大写、笔画沉重笔直——无法对笔迹。
facts.anchor: Printed, block capitals, with a heavy hand, straight lines.

facts.fact: April 职业回避：不是为 Dunning 地产公司干、但和 Brian 一起——帮着管理投资组合。
April 强调：与丈夫 Brian 并肩而非挂靠公司。
facts.anchor: Not for them. But with Brian.

facts.fact: 问到社交圈外的人——April 立刻变硬反问。
Alex 摊牌理论：这种杀法不是漠视——是执念/爱/恨；问「你们做过什么让人想杀你们」。
facts.anchor: You don’t kill someone in the way that Rebecca was killed because of indifference.

facts.fact: 「溺死」一词出口——April 脸上出现之前没有的抽动。
facts.anchor: Alex read the tic in her face at the method of death.

facts.fact: 律师 Adam Keller 只用名字就指挥 April 起身离开——权力动态；不是她叫的，是丈夫们叫的。
facts.anchor: The use of her name alone had carried the order to get up and leave. And she’d obliged.

facts.fact: Alex 推断：律师拽人是为了防她说出 incriminating 的话——而且很可能不是自证其罪的那种。
facts.anchor: Unless he specifically wanted to get her out of there in case she said something incriminating

facts.fact: Keller 的交易：只要十二小时，明早亲自带他们回来受深度问话。
facts.anchor: All I ask for is twelve hours so they can come to terms with Rebecca Cook’s death.

facts.fact: Alex 读局：Keller 立刻捞人还把「让他们哀悼」架成道德高点——反对它就成恶人。
facts.anchor: made Alex a monster if she argued against it

facts.fact: 章末结论：Rebecca 付了代价——很可能是因为 Scott Cook 做过的事。
facts.anchor: It was probably because of something Scott Cook had done.
